rapport_notes: Calm and professional but passive once the price objection landed — conceded quickly rather than probing further.

evidence_quotes.agenda: Before I go over with our pricing structure and your estimate, do you have any specific concern or stresser about the moving process in general? / Customer: 'No.'
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — customer raised no concern when asked.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: keep in mind we are a time based company. So you will be charged for the total time consumed by the end of the move.

top_strength: Kept a friendly, no-pressure tone even after the customer flatly said Einstein was too expensive, ending the call on good terms.
coaching_note: When the customer said 'you're way too expensive,' the rep conceded immediately ('I see what you mean') instead of asking what he'd been quoted elsewhere or re-anchoring on differentiators — a real save-the-sale opportunity went unused.
